slides.texte_overlay:
5 daily habits that will
improved your life

1. Drink a glass of water
when you wake up.
A simple start before coffee.

2. Walk after lunch.
Ten minutes clears the
afternoon fog.

3. Phone away an hour
before bed.
Your evening gets quieter.

4. Reach out to one person.
A message, a call, a coffee.

5. Learn something small.
Five minutes, every day.
